outside: The Gate is behind you. You are outside.
Quiet. The ground is uneven, the air is moving, and the horizon is further away than any wall you have known.

alone.gratitude: Nobody beside you. The air is cold and enormous, and it is yours.
alone.turn: ...but I worry about the others. Can't we all be freed?

card.title: QUIET HOURS: COUNTERSIGN
card.tagline: They got out. Now they're going back.
